long_description:
Workpay helps companies hire, pay, manage, and stay compliant across Africa.
We provide payroll software, payroll outsourcing, Employer of Record services, statutory compliance, benefits, HR tools, and salary disbursements for local and cross-border teams.
Companies use Workpay as their workforce infrastructure partner across 50+ African countries.
